name: drawman
description: Ask Copilot for an architecture, flowchart, sequence, state, class or ER diagram and watch it build itself live in chat as an editable draw.io diagram.

commands.title: Draw the architecture of this workspace

drawman.llm.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Optional OpenAI-compatible endpoint for repository analysis (e.g. `https://api.openai.com/v1`, a LiteLLM gateway). Leave empty to use Copilot's own model through MCP sampling. User setting only: a workspace cannot redirect your stored key.

drawman.llm.keyHeader.markdownDescription: Header carrying the key. `Authorization` sends `Bearer <key>`; gateways may use e.g. `x-api-key`.

drawman.githubHost.description: Host used for owner/repo shorthands (e.g. a GitHub Enterprise Server).

drawman.profile.description: Path to an organisation profile JSON (conventions, vocabulary hints, internal endpoints).

drawman.allowRemoteClone.description: Allow analyze_repository to clone remote repositories (otherwise only workspace folders).

scripts.package: node -e "for (const f of ['LICENSE','NOTICE']) require('fs').copyFileSync('../'+f, f)" && npx --yes @vscode/vsce@3 package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out ../dist/drawman.vsix
